arguments.message: No – downgrading a plan doesn’t delete your data. Any features or data tied to the higher tier simply become hidden, and the underlying data stays in the workspace. The only exception is if the lower‑tier plan has a shorter retention window – records older than that window will eventually age out, just as they would on a workspace that started on that tier.
